plan.notes:
Per the 2026-2027 Texas A&M University undergraduate catalog: Political Science (BA). Prerequisites are not listed in the catalog's plan of study grid; consult course descriptions.
Catalog footnotes:
[grid1 fn1] Must make a grade of C or better.
[grid1 fn2] Complete 14 hours of a foreign language through the intermediate level. If you choose to enroll in a language you have studied previously without receiving college credit, you must first take a placement test. Select in consultation with an academic advisor.
[grid1 fn3] Select from MATH 140 , MATH 142 , MATH 151 , MATH 152 ; PHIL 240 .
[grid1 fn4] Students must complete this course before taking more than 6 hours of 300- or 400-level courses in Political Science.
[grid1 fn5] POLS 100-499 cannot be used to fulfill this requirement.
[grid1 fn6] Select from POLS 100-499 (except POLS 206 , POLS 207 , POLS 209 ).
[grid1 fn7] Select any 100-499 course not used elsewhere (except POLS 100-499).
